panels.description: Pilots with at least one detected arrival and departure at EKCH between 04:00Z and 08:00Z.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT cid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival') AS arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure') AS departures FROM flight_events WHERE airport='EKCH' AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T04:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z' GROUP BY cid) SELECT count(*) AS "Eligible pilots" FROM p WHERE LEAST(arrivals, departures) >= 1

panels.title: Early Bird eligible

panels.description: Pilots with at least one detected arrival and departure at EKCH between 19:00Z and 22:00Z.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT cid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival') AS arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure') AS departures FROM flight_events WHERE airport='EKCH' AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T19:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T22:00:00Z' GROUP BY cid) SELECT count(*) AS "Eligible pilots" FROM p WHERE LEAST(arrivals, departures) >= 1

panels.title: Late Night Owl eligible

panels.description: Pilots with at least four detected arrivals and four departures at EKCH during the event.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT cid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival') AS arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure') AS departures FROM flight_events WHERE airport='EKCH' AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T04:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T22:00:00Z' GROUP BY cid) SELECT count(*) AS "Eligible pilots" FROM p WHERE LEAST(arrivals, departures) >= 4

panels.title: Copenhagen Fanatic eligible

panels.description: Pilots with at least one detected arrival and departure at EKYT, EKBI, or EKAH during the event.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT cid, airport, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival') AS arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure') AS departures FROM flight_events WHERE airport IN ('EKYT','EKBI','EKAH') AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T04:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T22:00:00Z' GROUP BY cid, airport) SELECT count(DISTINCT cid) AS "Eligible pilots" FROM p WHERE LEAST(arrivals, departures) >= 1

panels.title: Regional Master eligible

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM flight_events WHERE event_at >= '2026-09-05T04:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T22:00:00Z'), cph AS (SELECT cid, max(pilot_name) AS pilot_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival') AS arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure') AS departures, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z') AS early_arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z') AS early_departures, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival' AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T19:00:00Z') AS late_arrivals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure' AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T19:00:00Z') AS late_departures FROM e WHERE airport='EKCH' GROUP BY cid), regional AS (SELECT cid, max(rotations) AS rotations FROM (SELECT cid, airport, LEAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='arrival'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='departure')) AS rotations FROM e WHERE airport IN ('EKYT','EKBI','EKAH') GROUP BY cid, airport) r GROUP BY cid), pilots AS (SELECT cid FROM cph UNION SELECT cid FROM regional) SELECT p.cid AS "CID", COALESCE(c.pilot_name, (SELECT max(pilot_name) FROM e WHERE cid=p.cid)) AS "Pilot", LEAST(COALESCE(c.early_arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.early_departures,0)) AS "Early rotations", LEAST(COALESCE(c.late_arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.late_departures,0)) AS "Late rotations", LEAST(COALESCE(c.arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.departures,0)) AS "CPH rotations", COALESCE(r.rotations,0) AS "Regional rotations", concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN LEAST(COALESCE(c.early_arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.early_departures,0))>=1 THEN 'Early Bird' END, CASE WHEN LEAST(COALESCE(c.late_arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.late_departures,0))>=1 THEN 'Late Night Owl' END, CASE WHEN LEAST(COALESCE(c.arrivals,0),COALESCE(c.departures,0))>=4 THEN 'Copenhagen Fanatic' END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.rotations,0)>=1 THEN 'Regional Master' END) AS "Eligible for" FROM pilots p LEFT JOIN cph c USING(cid) LEFT JOIN regional r USING(cid) ORDER BY "CPH rotations" DESC, "Regional rotations" DESC, "Pilot"

SELECT event_at AS "Time", airport AS "Airport", initcap(event_type) AS "Movement", cid AS "CID", pilot_name AS "Pilot", callsign AS "Callsign", origin AS "From", destination AS "To" FROM flight_events WHERE airport IN ('EKCH','EKYT','EKBI','EKAH') AND event_at >= '2026-09-05T04:00:00Z' AND event_at < '2026-09-05T22:00:00Z' ORDER BY event_at DESC
